full_judgment: 50. First Information Report in a criminal case is an extremely vital and valuable piece of evidence for the purpose of corroborating the oral evidence adduced at the trial. The object of insisting upon prompt lodging of Report to Police in respect of commission of an offence is to obtain early information regarding the circumstances in which the crime was committed, the names of actual culprits and the part played by them as well as the names of the witnesses present at the scene of occurrence. Delay in lodging first information report quite often results in embellishment and embroidery which are creatures of afterthought. On account of delay, the Report not only gets bereft of the advantage of spontaneity, danger, also, creeps in introduction of colored version, exaggerated account or concocted story as a result of deliberation and consultation. Court always viewed and views a delayed first information report with suspicion and there may be a legal inference and presumption that the delay was and is for manipulation of prosecution case.
